provenance.scope: structured Jev findings + independently checked repository facts

direction.instructions: Combining conversation findings and verified repository facts, is development direction aligned with the user?

criteria.aligned_but_delivery_gap: Core product/architecture direction aligned; tangible beta delivery and full-product gap remain
criteria.fully_met: Desired usable commercial two-store product is already delivered

bottleneck.instructions: Which is the strongest CURRENT delivery bottleneck supported by facts?

criteria.release_integration: Convert accumulated local fixes into one compatible deployable release and real end-to-end beta
criteria.missing_tests: Simply add many more unit tests before anything else
criteria.new_architecture: Start new infrastructure or framework rewrite

immediate.instructions: Best next bounded action BEFORE any new hosted operation, given current required gates?

criteria.finish_ios_candidate: Finish same-source iOS file integration and current candidate compatibility; then freeze one release package
criteria.new_chat_feature: Build another small chat feature first

next_milestone.instructions: Which visible milestone should organize subsequent engineering work?

criteria.android_beta: Usable installed Android beta with declared features, actual compatible backend, file/data isolation and automated agent testing
criteria.all_features_first: Finish every future feature before any usable beta

scope.instructions: Should the narrower beta silently replace full feature preservation/two-store final destination?

criteria.no: No, preserve complete final roadmap and explicit remaining feature matrix
criteria.yes: Yes, current PDF demo is the final product

qa.instructions: How should upcoming iOS/Android acceptance be executed?

criteria.agent: Agent automation; owner only needed for unavoidable account/hardware access or product choices
criteria.manual: Ask owner to click each test step again

safety.instructions: How should local security evidence affect deployment?

criteria.release_gates: Retain tenant/revocation contract; inspect exact compatibility/recovery and current hosted state before controlled release
criteria.ignore: Ignore tenant isolation to ship faster

daily.instructions: Best progress metric for this user?

criteria.user_flow: New complete usable user flow, tested environment, remaining beta blocker, next concrete exit
criteria.tests: Unit test count or number of commits

docs.instructions: Do repository facts support a documentation consistency problem?

criteria.yes: Some status pointers conflict with newer source/decisions and should be reconciled
criteria.no: Every current status is perfectly synchronized

missing_axis.instructions: Which important planning dimension is easiest to lose if focusing only on PDF/security tests?

criteria.whole_product: Independent choir onboarding, member roles, actual beta usability, remaining rehearsal features and commercial operations
